title: VDBE trigger SubProgram intrusive linkage and presence

scope.rationale: sqlite3VdbeLinkSubProgram and sqlite3VdbeHasSubProgram establish and query the Vdbe-owned intrusive list used to retain transferred trigger programs until statement destruction. SubProgram/pNext and Vdbe.pProgram are the complete linkage representation.
excluded_responsibilities: SubProgram operation-array construction and payload fields

external_source_responsibilities: Caller allocates and fully initializes each SubProgram before linkage
dependencies.caller_closure: Both active linkage/presence functions and exact intrusive owner fields are assigned. Payload construction and final destruction remain follow-on units.

inputs: Vdbe and live caller-owned initialized SubProgram
outputs: SubProgram inserted at Vdbe.pProgram head; presence result reflects null/non-null head
contracts.ownership: Link transfers retention responsibility to Vdbe. Prior head remains owned and becomes new node pNext. No payload is copied.
contracts.state_and_results: Repeated links are LIFO. HasSubProgram is an exact head-null predicate.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds connection mutex. No callback, allocation, or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No failure path. A linked node must remain live until source-equivalent Vdbe teardown.

representation_differences: No semantic difference; nullable extern pointers retain C intrusive-list identity directly.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker observes an empty Vdbe, allocates two exact SubPrograms, links them in order, and compares presence, head identity, second-to-first pNext, and null tail as part of a 366-observation trace.
oracle.normalization: Addresses normalize to exact node/head relationships. Boolean results are exact.

assurance.oom: No allocation in assigned functions; test allocations are explicitly retired after observation.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O/callback; caller mutex remains integration obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: Source assumes a live node not already linked; worker uses distinct zero-initialized nodes.
assurance.continuation: Linked order remains valid for future traversal; worker unlinks only for bounded cleanup after comparison.
assurance.performance: Constant-time head insertion and null predicate.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact Vdbe/SubProgram owners. Production trigger compiler and teardown remain unmigrated.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Integrate transferred operation arrays and destruction.

independent_review.notes: Requires trigger compiler/destruction integration, assurance closure, and independent review.
